dct_title_s: Map illustrative of Captain Willard Glazier's voyage of exploration to the source of the Mississippi River: drawn from delineations by his Indian guide Che-no-wa-ge-sic
dct_alternative_sm: Map illustrative of Captain Willard Glazier's voyage of exploration to the source of the Mississippi River: drawn from delineations by his Indian guide Che-no-wa-ge-sic
dct_description_sm: Early 1880s persuasive map by Willard Glazier, depicting his alleged expedition to the 'true' source of the Mississippi River at 'Lake Glazier', known then and today as Elk Lake and but one of several small ponds feeding Lake Itasca." -From dealer's description.; Relief shown pictorially.; Depth shown by form lines.; Hand colored.; Includes illustration, "Source of the Mississippi".; Explanatory note describes timetable of the expedition.; Watermark: "Crane & Co, Dalton Mass. 1886. Bond no 21"; Inscribed on verso: "Glazier's Fraud.
